name: keen
description: Design guidance and visual review for websites built with coding agents. Requires the local Keen CLI and Playwright Chromium runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Make websites feel thoughtful, polished, and consistent
interface.longDescription: Keen helps you choose a visual direction, improve real pages, and keep the product consistent. It spots generic or unfinished details and suggests better options.
defaultPrompt: Help me find the right look and feel for this site.
Make this page feel polished and less generic.
Check that this change still fits the rest of the product.
